messages:
Asha: Heads-up: vendor pentest booked Tues 2026-07-20 09:30-15:30 UTC. We need a brief permission-quiesce (no deploys, no role changes), an evidence-vault export with write-once retention, a decrypt-proxy pattern for KMS, and an owner for remediation tracking. Who volunteers?

Connor: I'll take permission-quiesce + deploy hold. Suggest quiesce 09:00-16:00 UTC to allow prep/post tasks. I'll publish the affected IAM roles list.

Rita: I'll own the evidence-vault export. Plan: assemble CloudTrail + host logs + network flow subset, create a sealed export (tar.gz) with object-lock Governance mode for 30 days, publish sha256 and signed manifest. No long-lived credentials to assessors.

Nikhil: For KMS, we will implement a decrypt-proxy Lambda that can assume an assessor-scope role and call KMS:Decrypt only for k/v tied to evidence objects. No key policy changes. Need assessor account ID and target prefix.

Asha: Good. Assessor acct is 787878787878. Platform: can you produce sealed export path and retention TTL? Also confirm we can deliver via presigned URL rather than opening buckets.

Ops Bot: Ticket SEC-PT-6212 created: permission-quiesce + decrypt-proxy + sealed-export. Owners: @Connor (quiesce), @Rita (export), @Nikhil (KMS proxy). ETA: initial artifacts in 48h.

Connor: Draft IAM quiesce checklist: pause CI/CD pipelines, freeze infra-terraform applies, block iam:CreatePolicy and iam:PutRolePolicy for service accounts during window, and create rollback plan. Will post ARNs.

Rita: Export details: pt-vault/exports/2177770001_sealed.tar.gz, manifest at pt-vault/manifests/2177770001.json, sha256 in manifest. Retain export for 45 days by default. Delivery via presigned GET URL valid 72h.

Nikhil: Decrypt-proxy design: ephemeral role assume by assessor, Lambda validates request origin and object path, then calls KMS:Decrypt with context-bound ciphertext. Audit logs will show proxy role ARN in CloudTrail. We'll ensure no iam:PassRole to assessor.

Asha: Oncall: if pentest activity spikes alerts, who triages? Connor primary, Rita backup. Use incident tag PT-2026 and follow IR-runbook for noisy scans.

Connor: I'll run a dry-run next Mon 09:00 UTC for the quiesce steps and validate rollback.

Rita: I'll perform export smoke-test and verify sha256 matches. Will include a small sample bundle in SEC-PT-6212.

Nikhil: I'll deploy decrypt-proxy to staging for the dry-run and record CloudTrail entries to confirm visibility.

Asha: Acceptance criteria (add to ticket): 1) Quiesce enacted and rollback tested; 2) sealed export produced and checksum verified; 3) decrypt-proxy logs show assessor assume + decrypt events; 4) oncall escalation path validated. Add one-liners to SEC-PT-6212 by EOD.

Connor: Added: "Quiesce validated + rollback tested."

Rita: Added: "Sealed export created + sha256 verified."

Nikhil: Added: "Decrypt-proxy deployed to staging, CloudTrail shows decrypt calls under proxy role."

Ops Bot: Quiesce window scheduled: 2026-07-20T09:00Z to 2026-07-20T16:00Z. Rotation jobs for alias/pt-vault-key paused during window. Note appended to SEC-PT-6212.

Asha: Thanks team. Pre-check Thu 15:00 UTC 20m. Ping here for blockers. :white_check_mark:
